given: the home screen stock table is showing one or more stock rows
when: the operator scans the quantity column
then: the quantity values are right-aligned within their column

independence.rationale: AC1 asserts the rows and their SKU/location/quantity content are present; this AC asserts the presentation of the quantity column (right alignment for scannability). The table can list every record correctly while quantities are left-aligned, and quantities can be right-aligned while rows are missing, so each can fail without the other.
